tooltips.context: Type a sentence about your project. We'll automatically extract roots and suffixes for you!
tooltips.roots: Core words or prefixes that represent your brand's essence.
tooltips.suffixes: Word endings added to roots to make them sound like a brand.
tooltips.minLength: Minimum character length for generated names.
tooltips.maxLength: Maximum character length for generated names.
tooltips.count: Number of top names to display after filtering.
tooltips.seed: A number used to initialize the generator. Same seed = same results.

howItWorks.title: How it works
howItWorks.step1: 1. Combinatorics: Mixes roots and suffixes deterministically using the Seed.
howItWorks.step2: 2. Filtering: Discards names outside the length limits, with repeated letters, or bad words.
howItWorks.step3: 3. Scoring: Evaluates pronunceability (vowel ratio) and memorability (length).
howItWorks.step4: 4. Ranking: Uses Levenshtein Distance to ensure the Top N list has phonetically diverse names.

messages.emptyState: Adjust settings and click generate to see results
